title: CKA: Certified Kubernetes Administrator
description: Hands-on, performance-based CNCF exam on administering Kubernetes clusters: installation and configuration, workloads and scheduling, services and networking, storage, and troubleshooting. In progress.

title: Terraform Associate
description: HashiCorp certification on infrastructure as code with Terraform: the core workflow (init, plan, apply, destroy), providers, modules, state management, the configuration language and HCP Terraform basics.

title: Computer Network Systems Administration
description: Two-year higher vocational program in IT systems and network administration: installing and managing Linux and Windows servers, network services, databases, virtualization, scripting and security.
